Free text is fine — no fixed fields required. If you know the shape already, these prompts help, but don't force it:

## What's the need
One or two sentences. The problem or gap, not the solution yet.

## Who it's for
Which plugin's user, or a new plugin's audience.

## Why now
The pain or opportunity driving this.

## Done when
How you'd know this is actually finished — testable, not a feeling.
